description: A provider-neutral query model (filters in nested and/or groups, sorting, paging) and translators to SQL (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, SQLite), MongoDB commands and LiteDB queries. No database drivers: callers run the translation.

Run PostgreSQL locally without installing it: named instances of any version in the background, SQL with readable results and errors, version and extension discovery, and a shared download cache. Built on MysticMind.PostgresEmbed.
